name: Self-Taught Brawler (S-Class Brawler Archetype)
body:
Self-taught brawlers are those who trade some of their flexibility with feats for more formalized armor and weapon training. They might have read of the exploits of a wandering master, joined a militia with no regiment of its own, or watched knights and other soldiers training from the other side of the courtyard.

A standard brawler can gain the following benefits by trading out other class features.

Close Weapon Flexibility (Ex)

At 2nd level, a self-taught brawler can spend a use of martial flexibility when he hits a creature with a close weapon and apply his unarmed strike damage instead of the base damage for that weapon. When he gains close weapon Mastery at 5th level, he uses his full brawler level instead to determine his close weapons’ damage.

This alters close weapon mastery and replaces the bonus feat gained at 2nd level.

Armor Training (Ex)

At 5th level, and again at 11th and 17th level, a self-taught brawler gains armor training, as the fighter class feature. At 11th and 17th level, he can select an advanced armor training option instead.

This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 5th, 11th, and 17th level.

Weapon Training (Ex)

At 8th level, and again at 14th level, a self-taught brawler gains weapon training, as the fighter class feature. At 14th level, he can select an advanced weapon training option instead.

This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 8th, and 14th level, and the maneuver trainings gained at 11th, 15th, and 19th level.

Improved Awesome Blow (Ex)

A self-taught brawler gains this ability at 19th level.

This alters the level at which the brawler gains Improved Awesome Blow.
